scope: Parsed JSON structure only; no transport, file I/O, clinical decision or completion gate

synthetic_validation.initial_issue: Unbounded integers could break JSON serialization
synthetic_validation.repair: Reported counts and selected position bounded to 2**63-1; valid component sum up to 2**64-2; no original giant integer copied

metadata_contract.selection: positional list index, no alternate-choice fallback
metadata_contract.content: presence, fixed JSON type, character length, strict UTF8 byte length and SHA256; no body
metadata_contract.reasoning: presence, fixed JSON type, character and strict UTF8 byte lengths/encoding only; no body or hash

limitations: Not integrated into any model runner or NOVA runtime
Does not recover missing old raw responses or determine upstream empty-answer causes
Reported usage metadata is not independently measured or reconciled
Content hashes are structural identifiers, not anonymization; any future actual per-response receipts remain private
No new clinical comparison; HBT02/HBT03 null results and non-adoption remain unchanged
One-dispatch reservations, no-retry rules and four-complete-response gate unchanged
